description: This Java source file defines the CatalinaContainer class, which manages the setup, configuration, and lifecycle of an embedded Tomcat server within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and configuring web applications, clustering, connectors, SSL, and valves.

classes.name: CatalinaContainer
classes.description: Main class managing embedded Tomcat server lifecycle, configuration, clustering, SSL, webapps, and valves within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the embedded Tomcat server with configuration, clustering, valves, connectors, and web applications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the Tomcat server and logs connector and server info.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the Tomcat server gracefully.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this container instance.

methods.name: retrieveTomcatEngineConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the engine configuration property from the container configuration.

methods.name: prepareTomcatServer
methods.description: Prepares and configures the Tomcat server instance.

methods.name: prepareTomcatEngine
methods.description: Configures the Tomcat engine with name and JVM route.

methods.name: prepareHost
methods.description: Prepares the host (virtual or default) for web application deployment.

methods.name: prepareVirtualHost
methods.description: Creates and configures a virtual host with aliases.

methods.name: prepareTomcatClustering
methods.description: Configures clustering for the host if specified.

methods.name: prepareChannelReceiver
methods.description: Prepares the TCP channel receiver for clustering.

methods.name: prepareChannelSender
methods.description: Prepares the channel sender for clustering.

methods.name: prepareChannelMcastService
methods.description: Prepares the multicast service for clustering.

methods.name: prepareClusterManager
methods.description: Creates the cluster manager instance.

methods.name: prepareClusterValve
methods.description: Creates the cluster replication valve.

methods.name: prepareTomcatEngineValves
methods.description: Configures engine valves such as cross-subdomain sessions, SSL, and access logs.

methods.name: prepareTomcatConnectors
methods.description: Creates and configures connectors based on configuration.

methods.name: prepareConnector
methods.description: Configures individual Tomcat connector with protocol, port, SSL, and other properties.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfigs
methods.description: Prepares SSL host configurations for a connector.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfig
methods.description: Creates SSLHostConfig with properties and certificates.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfigCerts
methods.description: Prepares SSL certificates for SSLHostConfig.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfigCert
methods.description: Creates SSLHostConfigCertificate with properties.

methods.name: loadWebapps
methods.description: Loads and initializes web applications with threading and context setup.

methods.name: getWebappMounts
methods.description: Returns list of webapp mount points for a given webapp info.

methods.name: createCallableContext
methods.description: Creates a callable task to initialize a webapp context.

methods.name: prepareContext
methods.description: Prepares a StandardContext for a web application, including resources, filters, and parameters.

methods.name: getWebappRootLocation
methods.description: Resolves the root location of a webapp.

methods.name: getWebappMountPoint
methods.description: Returns the mount point for a webapp, trimming trailing /*.

methods.name: isContextDistributable
methods.description: Determines if a webapp context is distributable based on configuration and webapp properties.
